recordingRecovered: The app quit unexpectedly. The recording up to that point was recovered
importTitle: Choose audio or video to import
importInterrupted: The import was interrupted. Import it again
errLocalOnly: Local only is on, so nothing can be sent to the cloud
errBadKey: The API key is invalid. Check the settings
errNoModel: The local model has not been downloaded yet
statusOffline: Offline. Processing resumes when the connection returns
errNoBaseURL: The server URL is not set
errNoSummaryModel: No model is chosen for summaries
listEmpty: No recordings. Start recording or import an audio file
apiKeyCompat: API key of the OpenAI-compatible server (optional)
localOnlyHint: While on, recordings, transcription and summaries are never sent to the cloud
staleHint: The transcript is newer than the summary. Click to make the summary again
replaceDone: {count, plural, one {# line replaced} other {# lines replaced}}
obStep1Body: transflowy uses the microphone to record meetings and your voice. When you press the button below, macOS asks for permission.
obMicSilent: No sound was detected. That is fine in a quiet place. If you did not allow it, turn on transflowy in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone
obStep2Body: You can change this later in the settings. You can record any time, even before it is ready. Processing starts by itself once it is.
obCloudBody: Accurate, and good at telling speakers apart and mixed Japanese and English. Recordings are sent to OpenRouter. About $0.10 per hour
obLocalBody: Recordings never leave this Mac. The first time, a model of about 0.6 GB is downloaded
obSummaryModelHint: An OpenRouter model name (e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5). Summaries wait while this is empty
obTrialHint: After you press it, say something for 10 seconds. The result appears right away
obModelBackground: It downloads in the background. You can go to the next step now
obStep3Body: This key starts and stops recording whichever app you are in. The menu bar icon works too.
deleteDetail: The recording's folder (audio, transcript and summaries) is moved to the Trash
speakersHint: The names are used in the transcript, summaries and exports. A blank name goes back to "Speaker N"
captureSystemHint: Records the sound that comes out of the Mac, such as the other side of Zoom or Meet, on a separate track
warnSystemAudio: Could not record system audio (recording the microphone only): {detail}
errNoSpeakerModel: The speaker model has not been downloaded yet (you can download it in the settings)
errDiarizeUnsupported: Local speaker separation is not available on this OS
localDiarizationHint: Tells speakers apart in local transcripts. It takes about 6 minutes per hour of recording. Cloud transcription separates speakers by itself
summaryEditHint: ⌘Enter saves, Esc cancels. Saving it empty deletes this summary
summaryRegenerateKeepsEdits: Regenerating replaces what you edited by hand
liveWaiting: Captions appear here when you speak
liveCloudHint: Cloud transcription shows its results in batches every few minutes. To see them right away, choose local in the settings
diarizeHint: Splits the speakers again by the difference in voices. The speaker names so far are cleared. If you know how many there are, say so for better accuracy
